# LibreKey client (copy)

The LibreKey client packages (client, license, fingerprint, request) copied from
github.com/mulcahyio/librekey at commit ab55666, so the
LibreDCM image builds without access to the private LibreKey repository.
Standard library only. These client packages are licensed under the Apache
License 2.0 (see LICENSE); the LibreKey server is proprietary and not included. Refresh with `scripts/sync-librekey.sh`.
